script:
Clark (Terrorist)
Congratulations, you have become Clark
Oh, you are a terrorist. This small prison can't possibly contain you because you're a strongman. What's even more ridiculous is that this prison has no surveillance, and the cells don't have real locks - they're just hung from the outside. You only need a somewhat long object to enter and exit freely. So you prepared a thin iron hook with rope or cloth strips tied to the top end. Through the small window on the cell door, you can touch the padlock, and with a little force, you can open the cell door. Your purpose in coming to this prison was assigned by the organization - to assassinate Johnny. You were imprisoned in October this year for intentional assault, 10 months after Johnny was imprisoned. Killing him is simple, but escaping after the murder would be somewhat difficult for you, so you must have a plan to disguise it or frame someone else. Yesterday was a good opportunity because Johnny was alone doing cleaning work in the bathroom, and the guard on duty was the most useless Steven. This was an opportunity, so yesterday afternoon you secretly slipped out of your cell. Your cellmate Andrew also needed to do cleaning work, so no one would notice your absence.
Oh, damn, this annoying guard was standing at the bathroom door the whole time. You had no chance to approach Johnny. You kept observing in secret, and you're certain no one saw you. Finally, you found an opportunity - Steven seemed to go to the toilet, and you walked straight into the bathroom. You don't know why the bathroom was particularly slippery today. Johnny seemed to have anticipated your arrival. You had a brief conversation. He hoped you could spare him and in return would give you a large sum of money, even directly pulling out a check. You rejected him and prepared to act, but Johnny hoped to end it himself. Thinking that Steven would return soon, you agreed to Johnny's request. Of course, you still threatened Johnny that if he tried to escape, you would come back to finish him. Then you returned to your cell. After a while, Andrew also returned, continuing to mutter his strange incantations. You didn't bother with him. Next, you need to consider how to leave this prison.
Early the next morning, you were awakened by guard Steven, who informed you that Johnny had hanged himself in his cell. You were satisfied, but a detective who came didn't think so. He believes this is murder, so you've also been identified as a suspect.
Your Dark Side:
You were sent by a terrorist organization. Although your organization appears to be a company that acquires valuable items on the surface, it's just a cover. Johnny often cooperated with the company but swallowed a sum of money, causing operational difficulties for the organization for a period. To eliminate all interference with the organization's development, if others discovered you were from a terrorist organization, you'd probably be detained forever. Oh, right, your organization always communicates using code words. If others see these codes, you can tell them these are your research on some ancient script.
Character Relationships:

1601 John & Ken - You have no contact with them, they avoid you, your terrifying strength has scared too many people
1603 Andrew - Your cellmate who worships his god. You don't bother with him, anyway he never bothers you
Guard Steven - Someday you'll kill him because you find him completely disagreeable, always greedy for small gains
Janitor George - Oh, is there such a person? How do I not know?

Your Statement to the Detective:
Respected Detective:
I don't know why you want to interfere in a boring suicide case. I also don't know who that person next to me is. His death has nothing to do with me. I just want to leave this damn place as soon as possible. You ask when I last saw him? Can't remember, no impression. I heard he was a gang boss, so you should interrogate his subordinates and his enemies outside. As for why I was imprisoned, I just injured a thug and they arrested me. I've been here about 2 months now, but this has nothing to do with this case, right? I don't know anything else, but Johnny apparently offended quite a few people. Maybe there's a spy right beside him. If there's nothing else to ask, I'll go back now. Oh, right, Detective, I hope you can give some advice to the police in this prison - the cafeteria food is getting worse and worse. Also, I want a single room. That's all I have to say. I don't have any useful information anyway, otherwise I'd be restless knowing there's a dangerous killer living where I am.
acts_goal:
Find the killer
Guard your dark side
